reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread under his question: the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is **Gate 47**.

Before I read the channel, I checked that Hollis is a member of #central-team. On Oct 14 Pree posted Dock 23 there, then corrected it to Gate 47 later that day because she'd read the wrong line. My reply tells Hollis that Dock 23 is out of date, so the old figure doesn't end up on the account sheet. Nobody has changed it since her correction.
